decision: OPT-PROXY, decided by the Lead in 0089

fixture.why: The relay is never restarted, so the three addresses handed to the test process stay valid while the broker behind them is really stopped and really started. Measured twice that a restarted container is published on a new ephemeral port: 32955 to 32958 here and 33002 to 33005 by the Lead.
fixture.published: OpenWire, AMQP and Jolokia, on ephemeral loopback ports only. The relay reaches the broker by service name over the internal compose network.
fixture.licenceAndPlatform: GPLv2 with the LGPL runtime exception; the pinned digest is the manifest list and covers linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

controlProtocol.requestAndResult: schemaVersion, requestId, action and an explicit status on both sides
controlProtocol.publication: each side writes a .partial file beside the target and publishes it by an atomic rename on the same directory, so no reader meets a half written document
controlProtocol.interrupt: docker compose stop, confirmed as the broker's own state through docker compose ps - not a TCP handshake at the relay, which would report the relay's health and call it the broker's
controlProtocol.restore: docker compose start, confirmed as healthy rather than merely running
controlProtocol.addressAcrossTheOutage: unchanged, measured: the child kept OpenWire 33017 before, during and after

whatItObserves: delivery of a run owned identity before the outage, exactly once
the receive endpoint reporting Faulted while the broker is stopped, from the endpoint observer
the receive endpoint reporting Ready again after the broker returned
delivery of a second run owned identity after the recovery, exactly once, over the address the bus was configured with
whatItDoesNotDo: It publishes nothing while the broker is down. Measured: a publish issued in that state does not return - not the task, the call - because it resolves a send endpoint against a session whose broker is not answering.

first attempt.change: ReceiveEndpoint.IsUnrecoverable treats every ConnectionException as unrecoverable
first attempt.result: both cases stayed green, so that branch is not what drives this recovery. Recorded because a mutation that changes nothing is a finding about the probe, not about the product.

second attempt.result: both cases red with 'the receive endpoint never became ready again after the broker returned'
second attempt.conclusion: the case is held by the mechanism it claims to be about
